title: 1877. Minimize Maximum Pair Sum in Array

examples.explanation: The elements can be paired up into pairs (3,3) and (5,2). The maximum pair sum is max(3+3, 5+2) = max(6, 7) = 7.
The elements can be paired up into pairs (3,5), (4,4), and (6,2). The maximum pair sum is max(3+5, 4+4, 6+2) = max(8, 8, 8) = 8.
